messages.en:
I'm moving, and I hope
that you're a little more
stylish the next time we
meet. Sound like a plan?

I'm moving! And I'm kinda
sad. {0b 03 00}{04 11 00} was good
to me...although YOU were
a real handful!

I'm leaving {04 11 00},
but I'm not sad! It'll be
exciting to meet some
new, cultured people!

I'm moving, and it's sad.
But the IMPORTANT thing is
it's all about me. 'Cause
I'm moving. And it's sad.

I'm leaving town! I wanted
it to be a big mystery,
but I'm actually just
bored. See ya.
